subject: fish distribution based on a stream network

messages.author: 4930488f69589d77
messages.subject: fish distribution based on a stream network
parts:
All,
I was hoping to get some advice on how to proceed with developing a fish distribution model based on presence/absence data with the GIS attributes as covariates. I was able to develop this model using SPDE in INLA with a 2d mesh by using the geo-referenced fish presence/absence data and covariates using logistic regression.  However, when using the 2d mesh, I had a lot of vertices that were not informative since they were not on the stream network, which was not supplied since I only used the points. Also, without the stream network, INLA calculated the Euclidean distances between points.

I would like to use stream distance as measured between the points and not use Euclidean distance. My questions are:
1) Is there a way to import a large stream network more than 10,000km of stream with 3,000 sampling points in INLA?
2) If so can I use a 1d mesh based on the stream network to calculated the stream distance in INLA? If this is possible does anyone have an example of creating 1d mesh using a dendritic network (e.g. stream or roads).
3) I am most interested in inference for the data supplied not using INLA to predict to unsampled locations (I can predict outside of INLA), if this is a simpler solution.
4) If the approach I am proposing is problematic, I can calculate stream distance outside INLA and if so is there way to utilize the SPDE approach?

Thanks in advance for your consideration.

Dan
